Why did Arjuna choose Krishna over a whole army? Before the great war, Duryodhana and Arjuna both rushed to Dwarka to ask Krishna for help. As the story goes, Krishna was asleep.
Duryodhana walked in first, and sat proudly near his head. Arjuna came in quietly, and sat at his feet. When Krishna opened his eyes, who did he see first? Arjuna.
So Krishna made an offer. On one side, my whole army. A million soldiers. On the other side, just me. And I will not fight. Wait, who would choose one man with no weapon?

Arjuna did. Without a second thought. Duryodhana laughed, and took the army. But Arjuna won the war. That's why we say, choose Krishna, and everything else follows. Comment Partha if you would choose him too.
